text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle publicly proclaims her respect for Hishi Akebono and declares war on her in the same breath!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I fear Hishi Akebono might feel nervous after being openly challenged, but she confidently walks to the race with a smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd can't wait to see two of the biggest racers go head-to-head as the curtain rises on the Yasuda Kinen!
